build_alexnet_model: build a TensorFlow AlexNet model with configurable input shape and number of output classes
build_vgg11_model: build a TensorFlow VGG11 model with configurable input shape and number of output classes
create_vggblock_layer: create a VGGBlock layer with n filters and m convolutional layers followed by max pooling
create_vggdense_layer: create a VGGDense layer with n units and m fully connected layers with ReLU activation
review_vgg11_class: review the VGG11 class that assembles VGGBlock and VGGDense layers into a complete model
